description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for four different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three distinct datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis presents the three datasets in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 50 to 62 with a linear scale and tick marks at every 0.5 unit interval. Each dataset is represented by a group of four bars, with each bar corresponding to one method and distinguished by its unique color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection is solid blue, DAPO is light blue with diagonal stripes, PPO+Self-reflection is solid green, and PPO is green with diagonal stripes. For the Mathverse dataset, the accuracies are approximately 53% for DAPO, 53.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 53% for PPO, and 53.5% for PPO+Self-reflection. For the MMLU dataset, the accuracies are approximately 56% for DAPO, 56.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 56% for PPO, and 56% for PPO+Self-reflection. For the Physics dataset, the accuracies are approximately 57.5% for DAPO, 61% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 58% for PPO, and 60% for PPO+Self-reflection. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the datasets along the horizontal axis. There are no visual emphasis elements such as shading, bolding, or annotations on the bars themselves.
